note: Story director situation library on the new core (docs/design/director-on-core2.md). Ported from data/content/situation-types.json and draft pull request 3914. Structure only: no type holds a sentence; records fill every role and the English engine voices every line. Situation types are human moments only. Election night is folded into news-arrives and celebration with the elections engine as the cause; the door-knocking flow is folded into first-meeting and visit with the canvass as the reason. Each cause matches a director moment by its label, its counterpart, a thread turn or a callback reason; a cause whose producer the new core does not have yet names it in awaitingProducer and matches nothing. Each type's tag names its situation key (loss, threat, honor, news-received, favor-asked, vote-wanted, arrival, departure, routine; scripts/english-corpus/moves.json), its endpoint (money, bill, political, personal) and the banks' registers its lines are composed in; the coverage table (npm run words:coverage) counts the parts for every type, role, move and register. Formal procedures still run by their own engine's rules; the civic types (a race won or lost, a floor vote, a signing, a veto, an appointment, a recall, a public hearing, a press interview, a scandal, a law reaching someone, a campaign stop, a filing, a layoff, an eviction notice) are the human moments inside them, each naming its cause record in causeRecord and waiting for the director's producer.

fills.subject: The person whose moment opened the situation.
fills.counterpart: The other person the opening record names.
fills.household: The members of the subject's household that day.
fills.present: Whoever else the setting's records place there that day.
fills.classmates: People enrolled at the subject's school.
fills.coworkers: People employed at the subject's workplace.
fills.absent: A person tied to the subject who is away for a recorded reason or has died.
fills.authority: The subject's guardian on record: at home, a parent who lives with them, else an older relative in the household.
fills.poll-workers: The poll workers the precinct's polling-place record names for that election day.
fills.chair: The presiding officer the body's record names that day.
fills.members: The body's sitting members on record, other than the subject.
fills.press: The reporter the press record names.
fills.clerk: The official the office's record names at its counter.

settings.school: The school the subject is enrolled at.
settings.letter: A letter or message from someone away.
settings.venue: The place the opening record names.
settings.public: A public place in the subject's town.

timings.at-cause: On the day the opening record is written.
timings.effective-date: On the date the opening record takes effect.
timings.next-together: The next time the roles' records place them in one setting.

bearings.guarded: Holding back, wary of the other.
bearings.hurt: Wounded by what the other did.
bearings.nervous: Uneasy at something new or exposed.
bearings.solemn: Grave and quiet at a serious time.
bearings.tender: Gentle and close at a parting or in care.

scheduling.note: Calibration, owner-adjustable (docs/design/story-director.md, part 4). paces: about how many scenes a year a life carries in each band of childhood agency, and as an adult; a moment becomes a scene when it ranks within that many of the life's moments over the trailing days, itself included. openDays: how many days a scene stays open from the date its timing sets. householdScenes: moments that stage their scene at home whenever a member of the subject's household is in them, whatever their impact (owner, Oct 14, 2026, night: family scenes come from the household's own records; a mother asking the player to sit down for a lost job). householdRecordScenes: records of the whole household (the housing engine's eviction names every member) that stage a family scene at home for each member.

types.note: Election day is a scene (owner, Oct 14, 2026): the player goes to their precinct's polling place, sees the poll workers and neighbors the records place there, and casts their ballot as the scene's choice, never in a menu. The visit is the director's polling-place.ts: on the eve of an election the voter's day stops at the polls, with the household members who may vote; the ballot is the elections engine's, cast through the voting engine's castBallot. The poll workers are those the voting engine's polling-place record names for the voter's precinct.
